name: Bale Mountain Coffee
heroMediaAlt: Sweeping view of the Bale highlands and forest edge
positioning: Rugged, high-altitude coffee grown at the edge of the Bale forest ecosystem — the Group's signature everyday-specialty origin.

name: Gibe Gesha Farm
heroMediaAlt: Close-up cherry and varietal macro photography at Gibe Gesha Farm
positioning: A single-estate, heirloom Gesha micro-lot farm. Every lot is limited, numbered, and sold as an allocation rather than a standing SKU. The platform's flagship design reference.

name: Gibe Agro Processing
heroMediaAlt: Mill machinery, drying beds, and cupping table at Gibe Agro Processing
positioning: The wet/dry mill and processing facility behind multiple Kerchanshe farms — the platform's technical, trust-building B2B face.

name: Debka Farm
heroMediaAlt: Harvest-time cherry sorting and community life at Debka Farm
positioning: A community-rooted estate farm known for harvest quality and warm, approachable specialty coffee.

name: Gellana Farm
heroMediaAlt: Shade-grown canopy and understory at Gellana Farm
positioning: A shade-grown estate under a dense forest canopy — the Group's biodiversity and sustainability story.

name: Adami Tullu
